transcript.text: Let's talk about MCP or model context
protocol. If you ever wanted to connect
your AI agents or LLMs to real-time data
sources or external tools without
writing any custom connector, then MCP
is what you need. MCP is a protocol that
acts as a universal bridge between AI
systems and external data sources. For
example, imagine you are building an AI
assistant to manage your GitHub
repositories. Instead of writing code to
interact with GitHub, you can simply use
MCP so that your AI agents can perform
actions like creating repositories,
accepting pull request, creating issues
and lot more. Amazing, right? If you
want to learn more about MCP or see a
demo of using Kubernetes MCP server to
automate cluster operations, let me know
